LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice under Subsection (i) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that Government has intended to acquire the servitude of land given below for a public purpose.
Description of land to be acquired:
The servitude of land called Erbert Silva Watta (Musfer Estate) in extent of 0.3296 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 in P. P. No. P 4956 prepared by and kept

under custody of Superintendent of Surveys Puttalam, situated at the Village of No. 578A, East Pitipana in the Munneswaram Pattu in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Chilaw in Puttalam district in the North Western Province, to be acquired.

All the persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Chilaw Divisional Secretariat on 08 July 2015 at 10.00 a.m.

Further, it is requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate before 08 July 2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation, and details of the computation of such amount.
RANGANA FERNANDO, Divisional Secretary, Chilaw. Divisional Secretariat, Chilaw, 22 April 2015. 05-155
